name: investment.benchmarks

list.description: List investment strategy benchmark rules in the verified fixed date scope.

purpose: Inspect configured investment strategy benchmark rules and their native values; this inquiry does not execute investments or calculate realized returns.

fields.name: value
fields.meaning: Native benchmark value; preserve its original type and precision.

fields.name: valueType
fields.meaning: Native value interpretation; no rate or unit conversion is applied.

fields.name: effectiveDate
fields.meaning: Native effective date or timestamp, with its original timezone.

identity_description: Native id identifies a benchmark rule; zero is retained as a valid native value. No local identity is generated.
limitations: The POST inquiry pins tntInstId=GUAPW3SG, timeZone=GMT+08, valueDateStart="" and valueDateEnd="". No user date or scope filter is exposed.
Rows are data.data and the reported fixed total is data.totalCount. Pagination uses rowStart offsets and pageSize=5000.
Native unknown fields, nulls, empty strings, zero, decimal precision and date representations are preserved. Current production qualification is recorded separately.
